Date: 14th August 2026 
 
To 
Secretary 
Listing Department 
 
BSE Limited 
Department of Corporate Services  
Phiroze Jeejeebhoy Towers Dalal Street, Mumbai – 
400 001 
 
To 
Secretary 
Listing Department 
 
National Stock Exchange of India Ltd. 
Exchange Plaza, C-1, Block G, Bandra Kurla 
Complex, Bandra (E) Mumbai – 400 051 
Scrip Code : 540902 
ISIN : INE371P01015 
Symbol : AMBER 
ISIN : INE371P01015 
 
Dear Sir/Ma’am, 
 
Subject: Earnings Call Recording for operational and financial performance of the Company for the 1st 
quarter (April to June) of the Financial Year 2026-27 (‘Q1 FY27’) 
 
With reference to our intimation letter dated 11th August 2026, we hereby inform the exchanges that the 
Earnings Call with Investor and Analyst (“Participants”) to discuss the Unaudited Financial Results 
(Standalone and Consolidated) of the Company, for the 1st quarter (April to June) of the Financial Year 
2026-27 (‘Q1 FY27’) was held today i.e. on Friday, 14th August 2026 at 09:30 A.M. IST. 
 
Accordingly, as per the provisions of Regulation 30 of Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing 
Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, as amended, the audio recording of the said 
Earnings Call has been duly uploaded on the website of the Company and is accessible at the following 
link : https://www.ir.ambergroupindia.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Amber-Earnings-call-audio-Q1-
FY27.mp3.  
 
Kindly take the same into your records and oblige. 
 
 
Thanking You, 
 
Yours faithfully 
For Amber Enterprises India Limited 
 
 
(Konica Yaadav) 
Company Secretary and Compliance officer
M. No. A30322
 
Konica Yaadav
Digitally signed by Konica 
Yaadav 
Date: 2026.08.14 14:54:38 
+05'30'
